summary: Re-tested protected status endpoints, invalid-login throttling, request limits, hardening headers, trusted hosts, CORS, and frontend build/smoke load. Core unauthenticated protections and fresh 401x5/429 throttling passed; credentialed preview CORS preflight does not pass.

critical.issue: GET from https://sast-review.preview.emergentagent.com has no Access-Control-Allow-Origin, and credentialed OPTIONS preflight returns 400; localhost:3000 is allowed. This blocks browser credentialed API calls from the deployed frontend.

minor.issue: The fixed invalid-login test is not isolated from persisted login_attempts; after prior runs it received 429 on all six attempts. A fresh unique email manually produced 401,401,401,401,401,429.
No favorites, upload/SVG, or paginated catalog endpoints exist in the current starter-shell server, so those requested controls cannot be end-to-end verified.

integration_issues.issue: Deployed preview origin is not accepted by the public API CORS response, so future cookie-based auth requests from the frontend will be blocked.

issues: UI is still the generic starter splash and has no catalog, login, or status workflow; this matches the starter-shell context but is not a usable enterprise catalog frontend.

action_items: Ensure the deployed frontend origin is included in effective CORS_ORIGINS and verify credentialed GET/OPTIONS responses through the public ingress.
Make the brute-force regression test use a unique test identifier or isolate/clean its login_attempts record.
Implement and then test catalog favorites, pagination, upload validation, and SVG rejection; these routes are absent in the current shell.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS configuration in source appears to allow the preview origin for wildcard development, but the live response disproves that; inspect supervisor/runtime environment and ingress CORS behavior rather than relying on source alone.
Session digest, expiry, CSRF, and cookie flags are present statically, but no credentials exist to exercise login/session persistence end-to-end.

success_rate.backend: 80% automated regression (4/5); fresh manual throttling and status/header probes passed

seed_data_creation: None; no credentials or production data were created or modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Protected GET/POST /api/status, security headers, oversized requests, malformed public request rejection, trusted-host rejection, fresh generic login failures, and 5-failure throttling were checked. Preview credentialed CORS failed while localhost CORS passed. Credentials file is empty; authenticated cookie, expiry, CSRF, admin authorization, and digest persistence remain static-only.
rca of the issue: The public API does not emit Access-Control-Allow-Origin for the deployed preview origin and rejects its preflight, despite server.py's wildcard-development fallback containing that origin. Likely runtime/ingress environment or an upstream CORS layer differs from the reviewed source; compare effective supervisor environment and proxy policy.
